meta.label: COMPROMISED CARD - divisor 0.66, SIG /11. COMBO, PACE, SECTIONALS and COURSE all unsourced. Carded prices only, so no edge filter ran and no VALUE bets are set.
meta.sample: Bowen + Moruya, 14 races, full field scored

races.why: Won at Cairns last start for the new stable and tops the field on the RTG column at 100. Near the bottom of the weights at 56kg with a soft draw, and third-up in the prep. Only exposed form on Soft is a 4th, so the going is unproven rather than a plus.

Scored last start at Townsville off a four-week let-up and rates 100, the best in the race. Ran 2nd on Soft (5) a start earlier so the wet holds no fear. The 61.5kg is the one genuine knock and it is why the score is not higher.
Third-up and that is where this horse peaks, with 4 wins from 13 and a rating of 100. Blinkers go back on and the race fell apart with three scratchings. At $1.50 the market already knows all of it.

Highest signal count anywhere on the card at 7 of 11 - a prolific winner at 42:12-5-4, proven at 1200m and placed on Soft. Carries 62kg but the 2kg claim brings it back to 60. Beaten by Outback Action at this trip last month, which is the risk.

Third and second in her last two at Townsville over this exact trip, and rates 96 in a maiden. Ear muffs on for the first time. Beat Ceretti and Pulsating on the sourced variables despite both being shorter in the paper.

Tops the race on RTG at 100 and gets in well at 57kg. Only 0.22 clear of Excelboom and Electric Brae, so treat this as a three-way race rather than a standout. Recent form figures of 24467 are the weakness.

Won its last two and goes for the hat-trick, rating 100 with the best recent form in the race. Scored at Rockhampton second-up at 2/1 on 25 Aug. Wide gap back to Fabulean at 6.05, but it is favourite and priced accordingly.

Held up in the straight last start at Canberra and still ran on into 3rd. Rates 100 and has placed on Heavy (8) and Soft (5), so conditions are irrelevant to it. Gate 5 is inside the rail zone for a small bonus.
Ran 2nd last start off two fourths, rates 100 and draws gate 2 inside the bias zone. Light at 56kg in a maiden. Only 0.39 clear of Hampe, Magic Bus and Millie's Memory, so the race is open.

Best of these on every sourced variable - RTG 100, 55kg, gate 1 in the zone and placed at three of its five starts. Highest score at either meeting outside the two Bowen favourites. The price gives nothing back.

Won two back, rates 98 and gets the bottom weight of 55kg from gate 1 inside the rail zone. Nikita Zou at 6.68 is close enough to be a genuine threat and won more recently. Two-horse race on the numbers.

Weakest race on the card - the top seven are inside 0.32 of each other, which is no separation at all. Gets the nod on RTG 100 and a draw inside the zone. Carrying 62kg against that spread makes it a genuine avoid rather than a bet.

Won last start and rates 96, the best recent form in a weak benchmark. Gate 12 is outside the rail zone and takes a penalty, which is the whole reason it is not shorter here. Clearest margin of any Moruya race at 0.55 over Nagadec.

Biggest model-over-market gap on the card - rates 100, carries 56kg and draws gate 3 inside the zone, yet is $18 in the paper. Recent figures of 12155 include a win. Flagged as the divergence to watch, not as a bet, because the carded book here is 125 percent.
